	id = tu_hidden.1
	title = tu_hidden.1.t
	desc = tu_hidden.1.d
	picture = GFX_report_event_generic_read_write
	fire_only_once = yes

	trigger = {
		original_tag = URS
		has_global_flag = TU_chernobog_incident_started
		country_exists = REU
		NOT = { has_country_flag = TU_URS_serpent_route }
	}

	mean_time_to_happen = {
		days = 120
	}

	option = {
		name = tu_hidden.1.a
		ai_chance = { factor = 20 }
		set_country_flag = TU_URS_serpent_route

		promote_character = {
			character = TU_URS_kashchey
			ideology = despotism
		}
		add_ideas = TU_URS_serpent_shadow
		mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes
	}

	option = {
		name = tu_hidden.1.b
		ai_chance = { factor = 80 }
	}
}
